title: Pickled chard stalks with whipped feta on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Chard, cider vinegar, sugar, feta, yoghurt, oil and bread are all plain kitchen staples with no factory-made products.

supermarket.reason: Rainbow chard, feta, Greek yoghurt and dill are all everyday items at Tesco and similar shops.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a small pan, a frying pan and a bowl, and the techniques are simple slicing, mashing and wilting.

works.reason: The 1:1 vinegar and water brine, 200g feta for four toasts and 250g chard make a sensible snack for four.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers the slicing, mashing, wilting and toasting, and the 30-minute cook time matches the pickling rest.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item is used, 'rainbow chard' is a fair name for chard, and 'Season' covers the pepper.

seasonal_feel.reason: August chard is used both as pickled stalks and as wilted leaves, so it is clearly the point of a summer snack.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholemeal toast with feta, yoghurt and plenty of chard is a real-food snack a family would happily eat.
